name: Victoria Park Playground
description: Children's play areas in Victoria Park, run by Tower Hamlets Council, with a splash pool that runs 11am–5pm daily from the late May bank holiday to the end of the summer holidays (off when it rains). The park has two accessible cafés, accessible toilets and a Changing Places toilet.

nearby.label: Toilets with accessible cubicles and a Changing Places toilet
No cars in the park except blue badge holders (bays in the two main car parks)
